mainEntity.name: Do I need the 20-hour or 60-hour course?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 20-hour course is continuing education for registered preparers. People entering the CTEC registration process generally need qualifying education first. See the CTEC 60 hour course guide to compare that option.

mainEntity.name: Can I take a CTEC 20 hour course online?

acceptedAnswer.text: Online options are available. Check whether the school uses text, video, live instruction, or a combination, and confirm that the course is approved for the credit you need.

mainEntity.name: How much does a CTEC renewal course cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each provider sets its own price. Use the comparison directory to check published prices, then confirm the final amount with the school. Books, shipping, optional support, and package upgrades can change the total.

mainEntity.name: Does every course include unlimited exam attempts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not assume that a feature offered by one school is included everywhere. Check the provider’s assessment and retake policy, including any fees, before enrolling.

mainEntity.name: How can I verify a school’s approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: Search the school in the CTEC approved-provider directory and confirm its continuing education approval before paying.
